description: This Java class, PersistableCustomerOptionValuePopulator, is responsible for converting or populating CustomerOptionValue objects from PersistableCustomerOptionValue sources within the context of a specific MerchantStore and Language, primarily used during data transfer or transformation layers.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOptionValuePopulator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert PersistableCustomerOptionValue objects into CustomerOptionValue objects, handling description localization and validation.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableCustomerOptionValue into a CustomerOptionValue, setting its properties and descriptions based on the provided store and language, using the LanguageService for localization.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new CustomerOptionValue object; however, currently returns null, indicating it may be intended for subclassing or is incomplete.

methods.name: setLanguageService
methods.description: Sets the LanguageService dependency used to retrieve Language objects by code.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Retrieves the current LanguageService instance used within this class.
